verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê ’el- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl šim·‘ū də·ḇar- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And you son of man prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say O mountains of Israel hear the word of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E TU, ó filho do homem, profetiza aos montes de Israel, e dize: Montes de Israel, ouvi a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן אָמַ֧ר הָאוֹיֵ֛ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח וּבָמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ā·mar hā·’ō·w·yêḇ ‘ă·lê·ḵem he·’āḥ ū·ḇā·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·mō·w·rā·šāh hā·yə·ṯāh lā·nū
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Because the enemy has said of you Aha The ancient heights have become our possession
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Pois que disse o inimigo contra vós: Ah! ah! até as alturas eternas serão nossa herança;

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֣עַן בְּיַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְשָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִסָּבִ֗יב לִֽהְיוֹתְכֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַתֵּֽעֲל֛וּ עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן וְדִבַּת־ עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nā·ḇê wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an bə·ya·‘an šam·mō·wṯ wə·šā·’ōp̄ ’eṯ·ḵem mis·sā·ḇîḇ lih·yō·wṯ·ḵem mō·w·rā·šāh liš·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim wat·tê·‘ă·lū ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ lā·šō·wn wə·ḏib·baṯ- ‘ām
verses.literal: therefore prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Because . . . they have made you desolate and have trampled you on every side so that you became a possession of the rest of the nations and were taken up in slander by the lips of their talkers . . .
verses.literalPt: Portanto, profetiza, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto vos assolaram e devoraram de todos os lados, para que ficásseis feitos herança do restante dos gentios, e tendes andado em lábios paroleiros, e em infâmia do povo,

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְ֠הוִה לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָי֗וֹת וְלֶחֳרָב֤וֹת הַשֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְלֶעָרִ֣ים הַנֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְבַז֙ וּלְלַ֔עַג לִשְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִסָּבִֽיב׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl šim·‘ū də·ḇar- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh le·hā·rîm wə·lag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ lā·’ă·p̄î·qîm wə·lag·gê·’ā·yō·wṯ wə·le·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ haš·šō·mə·mō·wṯ wə·le·‘ā·rîm han·ne·‘ĕ·zā·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer hā·yū lə·ḇaz ū·lə·la·‘aḡ liš·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: therefore O mountains of Israel hear the word of the Lord GOD This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills to the ravines and valleys to the desolate ruins and abandoned cities which have become a spoil and a mockery to the rest of the nations around you
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ouvi, ó montes de Israel, a palavra do Senhor DEUS: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS aos montes e aos outeiros, aos rios e aos vales, aos lugares assolados e solitários, e às cidades desamparadas que se tornaram em rapina e em escárnio para o restante dos gentios que lhes estão em redor;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אִם־ לֹ֠א בְּאֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְעַל־ אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֑א אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ־ אֶת־ אַרְצִ֣י׀ לָ֠הֶם לְמ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה בְּשִׂמְחַ֤ת כָּל־ לֵבָב֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖הּ לָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- lō bə·’êš qin·’ā·ṯî ḏib·bar·tî ‘al- šə·’ê·rîṯ hag·gō·w·yim wə·‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm kul·lā ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū- ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî lā·hem lə·mō·w·rā·šāh bə·śim·ḥaṯ kāl- lê·ḇāḇ biš·’āṭ ne·p̄eš lə·ma·‘an miḡ·rā·šāh lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Surely . . . in My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Edom who took My land . . . as their own possession with wholehearted . . . joy and utter contempt . . . so that its pastureland became plunder
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Certamente no fogo do meu zelo falei contra o restante dos gentios, e contra todo o Edom, que se apropriaram da minha terra, com toda a alegria de seu coração, e com menosprezo da alma, para a lançarem fora à rapina.

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים וְ֠לַגְּבָעוֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֨ים וְלַגֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י בְקִנְאָתִ֤י וּבַחֲמָתִי֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי יַ֛עַן כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם נְשָׂאתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nā·ḇê ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā le·hā·rîm wə·lag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ lā·’ă·p̄î·qîm wə·lag·gê·’ā·yō·wṯ kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ḇə·qin·’ā·ṯî ū·ḇa·ḥă·mā·ṯî dib·bar·tî ya·‘an kə·lim·maṯ gō·w·yim nə·śā·ṯem
verses.literal: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and tell the mountains and hills the ravines and valleys that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I have spoken in My burning zeal because you have endured the reproach of the nations
verses.literalPt: Portanto, profetiza sobre a terra de Israel, e dize aos montes, e aos outeiros, aos rios e aos vales: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que falei no meu zelo e no meu furor, porque levastes sobre vós o opróbrio dos gentios.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֑י אִם־ לֹ֤א הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָכֶ֣ם מִסָּבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כְּלִמָּתָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ă·nî nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ’im- lō hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lā·ḵem mis·sā·ḇîḇ hêm·māh kə·lim·mā·ṯām yiś·śā·’ū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says I have sworn with an uplifted hand that surely . . . the nations around you . . . will endure reproach of their own
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eu levantei a minha mão, para que os gentios, que estão ao redor de vós, levem o seu opróbrio.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl ‘an·pə·ḵem tit·tê·nū ū·p̄er·yə·ḵem tiś·’ū lə·‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl kî qê·rə·ḇū lā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: But you O mountains of Israel will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel for they will soon come home
verses.literalPt: Mas vós, ó montes de Israel, produzireis os vossos ramos, e dareis o vosso fruto para o meu povo de Israel; porque estão prestes a vir.

verses.original: כִּ֖י הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem ū·p̄ā·nî·ṯî ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·ne·‘ĕ·ḇaḏ·tem wə·niz·ra‘·tem
verses.literal: For behold I am on your side I will turn toward you and you will be tilled and sown
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que eu estou convosco, e eu me voltarei para vós, e sereis lavrados e semeados.

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אָדָ֔ם כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה וְנֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים וְהֶחֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’ā·ḏām kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kul·lōh wə·nō·šə·ḇū he·‘ā·rîm wə·he·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ tib·bā·ne·nāh
verses.literal: I will multiply the people upon you the house of Israel in its entirety The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt
verses.literalPt: E multiplicarei homens sobre vós, a toda a casa de Israel, a toda ela; e as cidades serão habitadas, e os lugares devastados serão edificados.

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה וְרָב֣וּ וּפָר֑וּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh wə·rā·ḇū ū·p̄ā·rū wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem kə·qaḏ·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·hê·ṭi·ḇō·ṯî mê·ri·šō·ṯê·ḵem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will fill . . . you with people and animals and they will multiply and be fruitful I will make you as inhabited as you once were and I will make you prosper more than before Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: E multiplicarei homens e animais sobre vós, e eles se multiplicarão, e frutificarão. E farei com que sejais habitados como dantes e vos tratarei melhor que nos vossos princípios; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽירֵשׁ֔וּךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה וְלֹא־ תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְשַׁכְּלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·laḵ·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ’ā·ḏām ’eṯ- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wî·rê·šū·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā lā·hem lə·na·ḥă·lāh wə·lō- ṯō·w·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·šak·kə·lām
verses.literal: Yes, I will cause My people Israel to walk upon you they will possess you and you will be their inheritance and you will no longer . . . deprive them of their children
verses.literalPt: E farei andar sobre vós homens, o meu povo de Israel; eles te possuirão, e serás a sua herança, e nunca mais os desfilharás.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם אָתִּי וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת גּוֹיֵךְ הָיִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ō·mə·rîm lā·ḵem ’ō·ḵe·leṯ ’ā·ḏām ʾå̄t·tī ū·mə·šak·ke·leṯ gō·yēḵ hā·yîṯ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Because people say to you You devour men and deprive your nation . . . of its children
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Porquanto vos dizem: Tu és uma terra que devora os homens, e és uma terra que desfilha as suas nações;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן אָדָם֙ לֹא־ תֹ֣אכְלִי ע֔וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ לֹ֣א תְכַשְּׁלִי ע֑וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·ḏām lō- ṯō·ḵə·lî ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡō·yēḵ lō ṯə·ḵaš·šə·lī ‘ō·wḏ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive . . . your nation of its children . . . declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Por isso tu não devorarás mais os homens, nem desfilharás mais as tuas nações, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי־ ע֑וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ לֹא־ תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’aš·mî·a‘ ’ê·la·yiḵ ‘ō·wḏ kə·lim·maṯ hag·gō·w·yim wə·ḥer·paṯ ‘am·mîm lō ṯiś·’î- ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḡō·yēḵ lō- ṯaḵ·ši·lî ‘ō·wḏ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or . . . cause your nation to stumble declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E farei que nunca mais tu ouças a afronta dos gentios; nem levarás mais sobre ti o opróbrio das gentes, nem mais desfilharás a tua nação, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם וַיְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּדַרְכָּ֖ם וּבַעֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם כְּטֻמְאַת֙ הַנִּדָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַרְכָּ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl yō·šə·ḇîm ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām way·ṭam·mə·’ū ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·ḏar·kām ū·ḇa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām kə·ṭum·’aṯ han·nid·dāh hā·yə·ṯāh ḏar·kām lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Son of man when the people of Israel lived in their land they defiled it by their own ways and deeds Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, quando a casa de Israel habitava na sua terra, então a contaminaram com os seus caminhos e com as suas ações. Como a imundícia de uma mulher em sua separação, tal era o seu caminho perante o meu rosto.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·pōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ă·lê·hem ‘al- had·dām ’ă·šer- šā·p̄ə·ḵū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem ṭim·mə·’ū·hā
verses.literal: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood they had shed on the land and because they had defiled it with their idols
verses.literalPt: Derramei, pois, o meu furor sobre eles, por causa do sangue que derramaram sobre a terra, e dos seus ídolos, com que a contaminaram.

verses.original: וָאָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּזָּר֖וּ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּדַרְכָּ֥ם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָ֖ם שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·p̄îṣ ’ō·ṯām bag·gō·w·yim way·yiz·zā·rū bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ kə·ḏar·kām wə·ḵa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām šə·p̄aṭ·tîm
verses.literal: I dispersed them among the nations and they were scattered throughout the lands I judged them according to their ways and deeds
verses.literalPt: E espalhei-os entre os gentios, e foram dispersos pelas terras; conforme os seus caminhos, e conforme os seus feitos, eu os julguei.

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וַֽיְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י בֶּאֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ עַם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וּמֵאַרְצ֖וֹ יָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·’ū šām way·ḥal·lə·lū ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî be·’ĕ·mōr lā·hem ‘am- Yah·weh ’êl·leh ū·mê·’ar·ṣōw yā·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: And wherever they went among the nations . . . they profaned My holy name because it was said of them These are the people of the LORD yet they had to leave His land
verses.literalPt: E, chegando aos gentios para onde foram, profanaram o meu santo nome, porquanto se dizia deles: Estes são o povo do SENHOR, e saíram da sua terra.

verses.original: וָאֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִלְּל֙וּהוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wā·’eḥ·mōl ‘al- šêm qāḏ·šî ’ă·šer ḥil·lə·lū·hū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·’ū šām·māh
verses.literal: But I had concern for My holy name which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas eu os poupei por amor do meu santo nome, que a casa de Israel profanou entre os gentios para onde foi.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם־ לְשֵׁם־ קָדְשִׁי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lō lə·ma·‘an·ḵem ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî ’im- lə·šêm- qāḏ·šî ’ă·šer ḥil·lal·tem bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- bā·ṯem šām
verses.literal: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says It is not for your sake that I will act O house of Israel but . . . for My holy name which you profaned among the nations to which you went . . .
verses.literalPt: Dize portanto à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Não é por respeito a vós que eu faço isto, ó casa de Israel, mas pelo meu santo nome, que profanastes entre as nações para onde fostes.

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת־ שְׁמִ֣י הַגָּד֗וֹל הַֽמְחֻלָּל֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְיָדְע֨וּ הַגּוֹיִ֜ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qid·daš·tî ’eṯ- šə·mî hag·gā·ḏō·wl ham·ḥul·lāl bag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ḥil·lal·tem bə·ṯō·w·ḵām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·hiq·qā·ḏə·šî ḇā·ḵem lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: I will show the holiness of My great name which has been profaned among the nations the name you have profaned among them Then the nations will know that I am the LORD declares the Lord GOD when I show My holiness in you before their eyes
verses.literalPt: E eu santificarei o meu grande nome, que foi profanado entre os gentios, o qual profanastes no meio deles; e os gentios saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, diz o Senhor DEUS, quando eu for santificado aos seus olhos.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hag·gō·w·yim wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’aḏ·maṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries and I will bring you back into your own land
verses.literalPt: E vos tomarei dentre os gentios, e vos congregarei de todas as terras, e vos trarei para a vossa terra.

verses.original: וְזָרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכָּל־ גִּלּ֥וּלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·raq·tî ‘ă·lê·ḵem ma·yim ṭə·hō·w·rîm ū·ṭə·har·tem mik·kōl ṭum·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·mik·kāl- gil·lū·lê·ḵem ’ă·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: I will also sprinkle clean water on you and you will be clean I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols
verses.literalPt: Então aspergirei água pura sobre vós, e ficareis purificados; de todas as vossas imundícias e de todos os vossos ídolos vos purificarei.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ לֵ֣ב חָדָ֔שׁ וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־ לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem lêḇ ḥā·ḏāš wə·rū·aḥ ḥă·ḏā·šāh ’et·tên bə·qir·bə·ḵem wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- lêḇ hā·’e·ḇen mib·bə·śar·ḵem wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem lêḇ bā·śār
verses.literal: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart . . . of flesh
verses.literalPt: E dar-vos-ei um coração novo, e porei dentro de vós um espírito novo; e tirarei da vossa carne o coração de pedra, e vos darei um coração de carne.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ רוּחִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ בְּחֻקַּי֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- rū·ḥî ’et·tên bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- bə·ḥuq·qay tê·lê·ḵū ū·miš·pā·ṭay tiš·mə·rū wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause - you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances
verses.literalPt: E porei dentro de vós o meu Espírito, e farei que andeis nos meus estatutos, e guardeis os meus juízos, e os observeis.

verses.original: וִישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·šaḇ·tem bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem lî lə·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers you will be My people and I will be your God
verses.literalPt: E habitareis na terra que eu dei a vossos pais e vós sereis o meu povo, e eu serei o vosso Deus.

verses.original: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֤אתִי אֶל־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ṭum·’ō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·qā·rā·ṯî ’el- had·dā·ḡān wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’ō·ṯōw wə·lō- ’et·tên ‘ă·lê·ḵem rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: I will save you from all your uncleanness I will summon . . . the grain and make it plentiful and I will not bring famine upon you
verses.literalPt: E livrar-vos-ei de todas as vossas imundícias; e chamarei o trigo, e o multiplicarei, e não trarei fome sobre vós.

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת־ פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ וּתְנוּבַ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א תִקְח֥וּ ע֛וֹד חֶרְפַּ֥ת רָעָ֖ב בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hir·bê·ṯî ’eṯ- pə·rî hā·‘êṣ ū·ṯə·nū·ḇaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer lō ṯiq·ḥū ‘ō·wḏ ḥer·paṯ rā·‘āḇ bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: I will also make the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field plentiful so that you will no longer bear reproach among the nations on account of famine
verses.literalPt: E multiplicarei o fruto das árvores, e a novidade do campo, para que nunca mais recebais o opróbrio da fome entre os gentios.

verses.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ טוֹבִ֑ים וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·ḵar·tem ’eṯ- dar·ḵê·ḵem hā·rā·‘îm ū·ma·‘al·lê·ḵem ’ă·šer lō- ṭō·w·ḇîm ū·nə·qō·ṭō·ṯem bip̄·nê·ḵem ‘al ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem wə·‘al tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds - . . . and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and abominations
verses.literalPt: Então vos lembrareis dos vossos maus caminhos, e dos vossos feitos, que não foram bons; e tereis nojo em vós mesmos das vossas iniqüidades e das vossas abominações.

verses.original: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי־ עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָכֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְהִכָּלְמ֛וּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō lə·ma·‘an·ḵem ’ă·nî- ‘ō·śeh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh yiw·wā·ḏa‘ lā·ḵem bō·wō·šū wə·hik·kā·lə·mū mid·dar·ḵê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: It is not for your sake that I will act declares the Lord GOD let it be known to you Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Não é por amor de vós que eu faço isto, diz o Senhor DEUS; notório vos seja; envergonhai-vos, e confundi-vos por causa dos vossos caminhos, ó casa de Israel.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְנִבְנ֖וּ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·yō·wm ṭa·hă·rî ’eṯ·ḵem mik·kōl ‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm wə·niḇ·nū he·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says On the day I cleanse you from all your iniquities I will cause the cities to be resettled and the ruins to be rebuilt
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: No dia em que eu vos purificar de todas as vossas iniqüidades, então farei com que sejam habitadas as cidades e sejam edificados os lugares devastados.

verses.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֖ה תֵּֽעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ han·nə·šam·māh tê·‘ā·ḇêḏ ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh šə·mā·māh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ō·w·ḇêr
verses.literal: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through
verses.literalPt: E a terra assolada será lavrada, em lugar de estar assolada aos olhos de todos os que passavam.

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַלֵּ֙זוּ֙ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּגַן־ עֵ֑דֶן וְהֶעָרִ֧ים הֶחֳרֵב֛וֹת וְהַֽנְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְהַנֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū hā·’ā·reṣ hal·lê·zū han·nə·šam·māh hā·yə·ṯāh kə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen wə·he·‘ā·rîm he·ḥo·rê·ḇō·wṯ wə·han·šam·mō·wṯ wə·han·ne·hĕ·rā·sō·wṯ bə·ṣū·rō·wṯ yā·šā·ḇū
verses.literal: Then they will say This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden The cities that were once ruined desolate and destroyed are now fortified and inhabited
verses.literalPt: E dirão: Esta terra assolada ficou como jardim do Éden: e as cidades solitárias, e assoladas, e destruídas, estão fortalecidas e habitadas.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ הַנֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַנְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer yiš·šā·’ă·rū sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh bā·nî·ṯî han·ne·hĕ·rā·sō·wṯ nā·ṭa‘·tî han·nə·šam·māh ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and I have replanted what was desolate I the LORD have spoken and I will do it
verses.literalPt: Então saberão os gentios, que tiverem ficado ao redor de vós, que eu, o SENHOR, tenho reedificado as cidades destruídas, e plantado o que estava devastado. Eu, o SENHOR, o disse e o farei.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֛את אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם כַּצֹּ֖אן אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘ō·wḏ zōṯ ’id·dā·rêš lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·hem ’ar·beh ’ō·ṯām kaṣ·ṣōn ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Once again I will hear the plea of the house of Israel and do for them this I will multiply their people like a flock
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda por isso serei solicitado pela casa de Israel, que lho faça; multiplicar-lhes-ei os homens, como a um rebanho.

verses.original: כְּצֹ֣אן קָֽדָשִׁ֗ים כְּצֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּמ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֤ן תִּהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הֶחֳרֵב֔וֹת מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣōn qā·ḏā·šîm kə·ṣōn yə·rū·šā·lim bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏe·hā kên tih·ye·nāh he·‘ā·rîm he·ḥo·rê·ḇō·wṯ mə·lê·’ō·wṯ ṣōn ’ā·ḏām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Like the numerous flocks for sacrifices . . . at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Como o rebanho santificado, como o rebanho de Jerusalém nas suas solenidades, assim as cidades desertas se encherão de rebanhos de homens; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
